name: Insured Benefit
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/INS) — X12 005010 INS segment element reference. New for Phase 3 (270/271), used at 2100C/2100D to carry INS01 (Y=subscriber is the insured / N=this is a dependent) and INS02 (Individual Relationship Code — same code set PAT02/SBR02 already use elsewhere in this schema library, e.g. '18'=Self, '01'=Spouse, '19'=Child). INS03-05 (maintenance type/reason, benefit status) modeled as flat elements since they're situational, single-occurrence, no composite complexity.

Extended for EDI Phase 7 (834 Benefit Enrollment, September 2026) with the full remaining generic shape (pos 6-17, re-fetched directly from Stedi's own structured page data): INS06 (Medicare Status, a composite — Medicare Plan Code + up to 3 Eligibility Reason Codes), INS07 (COBRA Qualifying Event Code), INS08 (Employment Status Code), INS09 (Student Status Code), INS10 (Handicap Indicator, re-added — the prior 270/271-era note above deferred it, now in scope since 834's own member-level detail routinely carries it), INS11/12 (Date Time Period Format Qualifier/Period, same qualifier+value shape DTP already establishes elsewhere in this schema library), INS13-17 (confidentiality code, city/state/country, and a trailing generic Number field). Purely additive — no existing position 1-5 changed, so 270/271/837's own existing INS usage is unaffected.
